title: Polynomial-Time Pairing
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be polynomial-time computable functions from bit strings to bit strings. The function sending each bit string $x$ to the pair encoding of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced:
If $f$ and $g$ are polynomial-time computable functions on binary strings, then
so is $x \mapsto \mathrm{pair}(f(x), g(x))$: independently computed fields can be
paired without losing the original input needed by the second computation.
